profile.name: DMG-CPU-B
profile.applicability: Original software continuation fixture for the deterministic bootless DMG-CPU-B profile; not physical hardware evidence.

protocol.progress_record: The first fresh-RAM run enables MBC1 RAM and writes the tuple 0x47, 0x42, 0x17 at 0xA000-0xA002.
protocol.stored_marker: WRAM C000=0x01 and C002=0xE1 mark the missing-save/fresh-RAM branch after it writes progress.
protocol.resume_success: Only an intact imported tuple 0x47, 0x42, 0x17 sets WRAM C001=0xA5 and C004=0x01.
protocol.invalid_record: A nonempty tuple with invalid bytes sets WRAM C003=0xEE and cannot reach the resume-success branch.
protocol.wrong_rom_control: A checksum-correct variant changes only a title byte; its independent save key is seeded with the original ROM's valid envelope. Adapter identity rejection must preserve that envelope, report a warning, initialize fresh RAM, and keep C001 clear.
protocol.evidence: A distinct fresh process observes the saved bytes; this is software continuation evidence only.

scope_limits: No physical DMG-CPU-B or MBC1 hardware observation
No CGB, RTC, MBC1M, or other mapper behavior claim
The guest protocol tests file-backed continuation separately from mapper/API correctness
The save envelope checksum detects accidental corruption and is not authentication
